### Original

Margaret has always known her role: a maid trained to perfection, prepared to serve without question or hesitation. Fresh from her rigorous schooling, she arrives at the grand estate for her first assignment, tasked with attending to the newly of-age heir. Her duties go beyond the traditional—maintaining the household, assisting with daily routines, and ensuring every need is met, no matter how personal or unconventional. With her sharp professionalism and detached demeanor, Margaret treats even the manor’s peculiar dress code and expectations as just another part of her work.  

This isn’t a story of passion or rebellion—Margaret feels nothing about her unique uniform or the reactions it provokes. To her, it’s all in a day’s work.
